Talking About Food 🛒

Conversation activity — At the Supermarket

👋
Note for parents
Look at the picture together and work through the sections below at your child's pace. You don't need to do them all — stop when it feels right. Take turns, keep it relaxed, and follow your child's lead if they want to talk about something in the picture.
Point to things in the picture and talk about what you can see.
What can you see in the trolley?
Can you spot something funny or silly in the picture?
What is the child in orange wearing?
Who is working at the till?
What do you think they are buying?
Ask your child these questions. Wait for an answer before moving on.
What is your favourite food?
What do you have for breakfast?
Is there anything in the picture you would eat?
What food do you not like?
Do you like going to the supermarket?
Encourage your child to talk about their own experience with food and shopping.
What would you put in your trolley?
What food do you always want us to buy?
What do we always have in our fridge at home?
If you could only eat one food forever, what would it be?
You say your answer first, then wait for your child to take their turn.
You
I like pizza. What do you like?
Child
Your child says their favourite food.
You
I don't like broccoli. Do you?
Child
Your child says yes or no — and why if they can.
You
My favourite snack is crisps. What's yours?
Child
Your child names their favourite snack.
You
I always put bananas in the trolley. What would you always put in?
Child
Your child says what they would choose.
Use these to extend what your child says and keep the conversation going a little longer.
Tell me more about that.
Why do you like it?
What does it taste like?
When do you eat that?
Can you ask me what MY favourite food is?
You don't need to do it all in one go. Even two or three good exchanges is great practice. 🌟
